title: The Curse of Arrav
start: Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah.
prereq_other: Fully restore Senliten from the 'Missing My Mummy' quest

ironman.t: To make mithril grapple unless obtained as a drop
To make a ring of life unless obtained as a drop or as reward from the novice quest The Lost Tribe

items.t: Crossbow and mithril grapple (with rope) or enhanced grappling hook on toolbelt
Familiar with remote view ability such as a macaw (level 41) or a ravenous locust (level 70)
Combat equipment to survive against a level #vardefineecho:arravlvl | 91 monster

recommended.t: Desert amulet 2 or higher for unlimited teleports to Nardah
Amulet of glory (to quickly get to the start point)
Dramen or lunar staff if not done A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift; or another way of reaching Pollnivneach and Nardah
Ring of charos (a) - reduced costs for magic carpet
Trollheim Teleport or climbing boots for mountain pathways
Salve amulet (e) - bonus enhancement while fighting Arrav
Varrock Teleport runes (3 air runes, 1 fire rune and 1 law rune) or a Varrock teleport tablet for quicker access to Captain Rovin

rewards.t: Arrav can be faced in the Dominion Tower

steps.t: Talk to Ali the Wise in Nardah (north-most building). [Chat: Accept › 3 Where is the tunnel entrance? › 3 Time for me to go to Trollweiss, then.]

sub.t: To get there: teleport to fairy ring Fairy ring | DLQ and run south.
Or teleport to Al Kharid and go south to Shantay Pass, then take a magic carpet to Nardah.

p: Directions to Lamistard's Tunnels from Burthorpe lodestone and God wars teleport

steps.t: Head to the snowy area northwest of Trollheim, enter the troll tunnels and head north to go through the tunnels, and then head to the east to Ritual plateau tunnels.

sub.t: Follow the directions on the map below to get to the Ritual plateau tunnels, or use Trollheim Teleport if you have it. If you travel through Death Plateau or Troll Stronghold, you must bring the climbing boots.
Prepare for combat before going through Trollheim as you don't have any access to bank in there.

steps.t: Navigate through the caves by mining the rubble; some rubble must be mined from multiple sides to clear it.

sub.t: Optional: pick up the stone, granite, slate, and shale tablets.
Optional: Search the small bookcase for notes (a-j) if you want to give all information to Ali the Wise after the quest is completed. There is no reward for doing so.

steps.t: Enter the room east of the caves.
Climb the stairs.
Talk to Arrav, who will attack you immediately.

sub.t: After he starts attacking you, if you do not auto-retaliate, right-click and attack him.

steps.t: Fight until he teleports away. The fight will pause multiple times for dialogue.
Enter the room to the south and search the tapestry on the west wall for base key and base plans.
p: The 'flame tapestry' in the top left corner must be searched

steps.t: Travel back to Nardah and speak to Ali the Wise.
After the cutscene, speak with Ali the Wise again.
Enter the nearby Uzer Mastaba pyramid.

sub.t: To get there, either run north-east of Ali the Wise, use the nearby magic carpet network to get to Uzer and run south, or teleport to fairy ring DLQ and run east.

steps.t: Enter the pyramid, head north-west through the imposing doors, then south, down the stairs and talk to Senliten for oil in a canopic jar. [Chat: 1 Talk about Curse of Arrav.]

sub.t: Players who have completed certain quests can also choose to head directly to the Pharaoh Queen from the pyramid doors.

p: Surges of energy sent through the waters
Arrav's heart, in the middle of a continuous Mahjarrat spell

steps.t: Use (do not eat) your dwellberries and ring of life on the oil in a canopic jar to obtain a full canopic jar.
Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.

sub.t: If Leela is in the mummy's tomb, she can return you outside the Uzer Mastaba [Chat: 3 Return to the surface].

steps.t: Go to the Varrock Palace and speak to Hartwin (northwest tower, floor 3) to travel to Chaos Temple Dungeon. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
p: An example solution to the keypad puzzle, combination "EIHC" was used

steps.t: Climb down the trapdoor.
Follow the path, opening three doors along the way.
Head east to the room with the range.
Equip your insulated boots then enter the pipe on the south wall of the room.
Run through the sewers and attempt to enter the next pipe.
Summon your familiar, interact with it and choose the remote view option.
Run to the room south of you, search all the tables for decoder strips and notes (k-z).
Right-click pick-lock on the chest to obtain the code key.
Go north to the room east of the pipe and operate the keypad and solve the keypad puzzle:

sub.t: First read the code key and memorise or write down the letters.
Drag-and-drop strip #1 over the line indicated by the first letter of the code key (A, B, C...).
The strip has a hole that reveals a specific number, this is the first digit of the passcode.
Use the up and down arrows to enter that number, and press the right arrow to move to the next digit.
Repeat this for the other three strips.

steps.t: Enter the room, equip your crossbow and mithril grapple, then grapple the pipe above you.
Take from the pedestal for a heart in a canopic jar, then teleport out.
Return to Ali the Wise and speak to him.
Quest complete!

p: Gas fills the area when alarm is sounded
